root_packet.account:
Parent question answered: AI art does not deserve the label "kitsch" by nature, but it earns it by default. The single thesis the essay should defend: kitsch is the default attractor of AI image-making, not its essence — whether an AI work is kitsch is settled by use, not by tool. This follows the contract's conflict policy: prosecution and defense are not averaged; each side's strongest point is absorbed into one line.

The essay's argument, synthesized from the children:
(1) Stipulate a working definition in the essay's own voice (def-of-kitsch's hypothesis, adopted per the policy that the definition brief governs terminology): kitsch delivers pre-digested feeling through proven formula, flatters the viewer's existing taste, and yields effect without effort. These marks are artifact-neutral — testable on the finished work without knowing its provenance — which licenses applying them to AI output.
(2) Grant the prosecution its strongest points: training on the already-approved archive regresses output toward the aesthetic mean; the prompt-and-select workflow delivers sentiment on demand without risk; engagement optimization rewards instant appeal; the visible slop flood confirms the tendency. This concession — kitsch as the tool's default attractor — is the nuance the thesis owes the prosecution, and it preempts the structuralist objection to "use, not tool."
(3) Deploy the defense: kitsch is a judgment about use, intention, and reception, not a property of instruments; formulaic sentiment (greeting cards, calendar art, salon formula) predates AI, so the proper target is the sentiment and its market; earlier media were condemned as mechanical and later produced art (stated generically, name-free); human curation can re-impose friction.
(4) State the discriminating condition: AI work escapes kitsch when the maker selects against the obvious, tests the model's limits, and takes responsibility for resistance the viewer can feel; it stays kitsch when output is accepted precisely because familiar sentiment arrives without resistance.

Boundary handling: def-of-kitsch's "blocked" status is resolved locally — the root's own separator_facts and shared invariants declare that no sources exist by design and that content is drawn from general-knowledge briefs with flagged uncertainty excluded, so the criteria enter the essay as the writer's stipulation, not as extracted authority. Flagged-uncertain attributions (Baudelaire 1859; Sousa c.1906) are excluded per policy. All four children reason from the same general-knowledge pool, so their convergence is merged, not double-counted; the essay must persuade by argument, not by stacking concordant claims. This packet is the evidence basis; drafting, title, and the 550–650-word count remain downstream.
